# Slidez — AI Stylist & Virtual Try-On App

Meet your AI Stylist. Slidez generates outfit ideas, visualizes looks on you, and helps you shop smarter. Free on iOS & Android.

## Getting Started

- [Download App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details): Get the Slidez app for free on iOS and Android to start using your AI Stylist today.
- [Add to Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/kdcmgmfnnheiegkakcbkdolehlgdlaak): Install the Slidez extension for Chrome to access outfit ideas and styling tips directly from your browser.
